name: Hag, Bone
body:
BONE HAG
CR 3

Dusty flesh shriveled around bones makes this crone appear more like a walking skeleton than a living creature.

XP 800
NE Medium monstrous humanoid
Init +0; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 10, flat-footed 14 (+4 natural)
hp 30 (4d10+8)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +1
DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune negative energy; SR 14

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +6 (1d4+2)
Special Attacks channel negative energy (7/day, 2d6, DC 14)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 4th; concentration +6)

At will—chill touch (DC 14), detect undead
1/day—animate dead, command undead (DC 15), hag’s touch* (DC 15)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 10, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 11, Cha 15
Base Atk +4; CMB +6; CMD 16
Feats Command Undead, Extra Channel
Skills Bluff +6, Knowledge (religion) +4, Perception +7, Stealth +7
Languages Common, Necril
SQ negative energy focus

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Negative Energy Focus (Su)

The hag wears an amulet carved of bone, which serves as a conduit to negative energy. While she wears it, she can channel negative energy as a cleric with a level equal to her hit dice and is immune to damage from channeling negative energy. If the amulet is stolen or destroyed, it takes the bone hag a week to create a new one, but the amulet has no particular power for other creatures.

ECOLOGY

Environment urban or underground
Organization solitary, rattle (1 bone hag plus 1–8 skeletons and 1–4 zombies), or coven (3 hags of any type)
Treasure standard plus carved bone amulet (worth 25 gp)

Although frequently mistaken for undead themselves, bone hags prefer to see themselves as the masters of the dead. However, most bone hags grudgingly understand their own weakness and are willing to feign undeath to gain an advantage over opposing priests. Some even go so far as to bend knee to powerful intelligent undead, like vampires and liches.

Left to their own devices, bone hags live in luxury, surrounded by undead servants. Unfortunately for nearby communities, most bone hags’ idea of luxury includes frequent meals of tender humanoid flesh and rooms decorated floor to ceiling with the bones of their victims.

A coven with a bone hag gains create undead and raise dead as spell-like abilities instead of mirage arcana and vision.
